crossRefs.note: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

translations.web: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
translations.bsb: The woman answered the serpent, “We may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden,
translations.kjv: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
translations.asv: And the woman said unto the serpent, Of the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat:
